predict.question: In case B, your afternoon has forty minutes free for twenty-minute tasks that can't be split, with no overhead. How many work minutes do you complete?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: The Effective Executive treats recording and consolidating time as a prerequisite for choosing what deserves it.
modelBoundary: A completes {A} work minutes; B completes {B}. One extra available minute makes a second whole 20-minute task fit instead of leaving 19 unusable minutes. Indivisible toy tasks only; unfinished chunks contribute no output and concentration is not modeled.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
